critical_code_review_comments: BUG1 fix (L668-677): prevIdxRef.current === idx short-circuit is correct and idempotent under React.StrictMode. On first mount, prevIdxRef initialized to current idx → no reset. StrictMode's second invocation still sees ref===idx → still no reset. On actual Next click, idx bumps to N+1, prevIdxRef lags at N, reset runs and updates ref to N+1. Clean solution.

BUG2 fix (L639-653): clean-start early-return properly gated (idx===0 && endsAt===null && pausedRemaining===null && existing.recipe_id !== recipe.id). Does not affect normal persistence — as soon as user interacts (Next click bumps idx, or Start creates endsAt), we exit clean-start and persistence resumes.
toast id 'rg-cook-resume' correctly dedupes StrictMode double-fire via Sonner's id-based dedupe.
File size still 1140 lines (>700 threshold) — extraction of CookModeModal remains a good hygiene item.
All 13 iter_41 failing/partial tests now PASS with fix in place. No regressions in T1/T5-T11 saved-flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both BUG1 (StrictMode double-invoke wiping timer state — fixed by idx-value guard prevIdxRef.current===idx short-circuit) and BUG2 (peek overwriting other recipe's session — fixed by clean-start early-return in saveCookSession useEffect) are FULLY resolved and verified live. React.StrictMode is still enabled in /app/frontend/src/index.js. The idx-value-guard pattern (const prevIdxRef=useRef(idx); if(prevIdxRef.current===idx) return; prevIdxRef.current=idx; ...) is the recommended replacement for any other useRef(true) boolean mount-guards elsewhere. Seed pattern for future iterations documented in seed_data_creation above. Onboarding tour is settings-based (settings.tour_completed), not localStorage — click Skip buttons or set via StorageService.saveSettings({tour_completed:true}).
rca of the issue: Both bugs were fixed at the source. BUG1 fix (L668-677 of RestaurantWorkspacesP6.jsx): replaced boolean mount-guard useRef(true) with idx-value guard useRef(idx). Under StrictMode, second invocation sees prevIdxRef.current === idx and short-circuits — no state clobber. Verified: localStorage.ends_at at +50/+200/+500/+1500ms all preserved. BUG2 fix (L639-653): saveCookSession useEffect early-returns when isCleanStart (idx===0 && endsAt===null && pausedRemaining===null) AND loadCookSession().recipe_id !== current recipe.id. Verified: peeking at B leaves A's session intact; clicking Next on B (bumps idx from 0→1, exits clean-start) correctly overwrites.
